mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d forward returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in the federal funds rate and inflation (FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has a positive Rank IC with 60d forward returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by high housing starts and strong consumer demand), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20d forward returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a weakening consumer demand amid monetary tightening, which is particularly bearish for equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * FEDFUNDS) has a positive Rank IC with 60d forward returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0.
